annotations.title: Try a new wall paint color

description: Repaint the walls in a photo of a room or house with a new paint color, to preview a color before painting (for example 'sage green', 'warm white with black trim'). Uses one House AI design credit.

color.description: The paint color in plain words, for example 'soft sage green'.
color.title: Color

photo.description: The room or house photo the user attached in chat. Filled in by the app, not typed.

photo_upload_id.description: The upload_id from get_photo_upload_link, once the user says the photo is uploaded.
photo_upload_id.title: Photo Upload Id

photo_url.description: A public https link to the photo, if the user gave one instead of attaching it.
photo_url.title: Photo Url

space.description: Inside walls or the outside of the house.
space.title: Space

name: paint_walls
title: Try a new wall paint color
